purpose: Define explicit retention rules over exact data/schema/scope identities, including duration/anchor, applicable lifecycle transition and policy provenance.

topics.name: DWH Retention Policy
topics.purpose: Define explicit retention rules over exact data/schema/scope identities, including duration/anchor, applicable lifecycle transition and policy provenance.

semantics.policy_rule: Each retention policy has an explicit canonical identity.
semantics.duration_rule: Retention duration or condition is explicit.
semantics.anchor_rule: Retention anchor is explicit, e.g. creation time, accepted revision time, project completion or other declared event.
semantics.transition_rule: Policy declares resulting action such as archive, expire, tombstone or purge-candidate.
semantics.priority_rule: Multiple applicable policies use explicit precedence/combination semantics, never file order.
semantics.classification_rule: Retention policy does not override classification/declassification semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: Policy eligibility does not itself authorize destructive transition.

invariants.rule: Retention, archival, expiry, purge and hold state are explicit lifecycle semantics over exact data identities; time passage, storage movement or archive location never silently deletes, declassifies, transfers ownership or restores data.

hard_gates.condition: multiple policies resolved by file order

references.purpose: Retention policies drive explicit lifecycle transitions.
